pr.body:
**New: Settings > Sessions.** Pick how a memo's session gets into the Claude app:

- **Open when the first answer is ready** (default, unchanged): `claude -p`, then `claude --desktop --resume`. Shows with your other sessions, but only after the first turn ends.
- **Open right away with Remote Control:** `claude --bg --remote-control`, read the `claude.ai/code/session_…` link from `claude logs`, open it as `claude://claude.ai/code/session_…`. Opens in seconds and updates live, also on the phone. Shows under Remote Control in the sidebar.

What didn't work (notes in the README): a `claude://code/new?prompt=` link only fills the box; resuming a running background session shows a frozen copy; the first flow can't get Remote Control.

**Also fixed:** local ad-hoc builds crashed at launch. With the hardened runtime on, macOS refused to load the ad-hoc signed Sparkle. Ad-hoc builds now skip the hardened runtime; Developer ID builds are unchanged.

Tested: `swift test` passes (new tests for reading the background id and the Remote Control link). Built app launches, the Sessions tab was checked by hand, and a real memo ran through the Remote Control flow.
